text:
Type: clamp spotlight with bell shade
Use: directed reading or accent light clamped to a desk, shelf or bed; home office, bedroom, living room
Style: industrial, retro, Scandinavian
Materials: cream powder-coated metal shade and bracket, steel screw clamp, grey cord
Colors: warm off-white cream, silver steel, grey
Shape: deep flared bell shade on a tilting bracket with a large knob, screw clamp with a flat jaw, chunky and compact, medium visual weight
Feel: sturdy, utilitarian, warm, vintage
Goes with: wood shelves, black or brass accents, brick or concrete; industrial or farmhouse rooms and home offices

product.name: HEKTAR
product.description: The lamp has got double function - you can use it as a clamp spotlight or assemble it on the wall as a wall lamp.
